Triple net (NNN) leases shift routine property expenses — property taxes, insurance, and common area maintenance — to the tenant, creating more predictable income and lower day-to-day management for owners. For commercial real estate investors, landlords, building owners, and business tenants in Chester County and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, NNN structures often suit single-tenant retail, medical, and service properties when lease language is explicit. Before signing, confirm which expenses are passed through, how CAM is calculated and reconciled, and whether caps or exclusions apply. Also verify lease term, renewal options, tenant creditworthiness, estoppel requirements, and who handles capital projects. NNN leases can reduce operational burden but may shift deferred capital risk to owners. Need a local lease review or tailored guidance?
